entities.summary: Paweł z Krosna was a Ruthenian poet and philosopher during the Renaissance in Poland. As a poet and philosopher, he wrote in Latin on Statius, drew heavily on the literary tradition of the "Leipzig School", and also heavily incorporated Italian humanist ideas. In addition, he drew on Horatian motifs in correspondences and adopted the model of atopic portraiture.
